repository.corpname: M.E. Grenander Department of Special Collections & Archives

did.abstract: University at Albany Faculty-Staff LISTSERV emails sent from 2014-2024.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: This collection is arranged alphabetically by sender. Each series represents a different sender that utilized the LISTSERV to send their emails, with further breakdowns for repeating themes or senders. These subseries are also arranged alphabetically.

bioghist.head: Biographical / Historical
bioghist.p: The Faculty-Staff LISTSERV is an email distribution list that departments across campus use to communicate to Faculty and Staff members en masse. Emails sent to the LISTSERV to notify the UAlbany Community of events, information, or opportunities that impact the whole campus community including (but not limited to) faculty and staff. And individuals can reply to these emails, which are also shared with the rest of the LISTSERV. Certain offices or departments on campus are given authorization to send "broadcast messages" to these LISTSERVs (not all campus accounts have access to all lists). There are three Faculty/Staff Broadcast Email Lists at UAlbany, ALLFACSTAFF(the Faculty/Staff LISTSERV of this collection), TEACHFAC (for the teaching faculty), and VOTINGFAC (for faculty and staff who are able to vote per the bylaws of their departments).

The departments that have been given broadcast authorization are: Academic Affairs-Notices, Athletics-Notices, Diversity and Inclusion-Notices, Finance and Administration-Notices, GSA-Notices, ITS-Notices, Office of Communications & Marketing-Notices, Office of the President-Notices, Research-Notices, Student Association-Notices, Student Affairs-Notices, Career Services-Notices, Neighborhood Life-Notices, Newscenter, TitleIX, UAlbany Alert Notices, UPD-Notices, University Development-Notices, University Senate-Notices, SEFA-Notices, and UAS-Notices.

There are also ten student broadcast email lists that the above departments can email as well. Some of the emails in the UAlbany Faculty-Staff Listserv Collection may have also been sent to the student broadcast lists, but it is unclear from the metadata that we have.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Access to this record group is unrestricted. Some emails have been discluded due to their reference of personally identifying information about potential job candidates.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: The researcher assumes full responsibility for conforming with the laws of copyright. Whenever possible, the M.E. Grenander Department of Special Collections and Archives will provide information about copyright owners and other restrictions, but the legal determination ultimately rests with the researcher. Requests for permission to publish material from this collection should be discussed with the Head of Special Collections and Archives.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: All items were sent to the ALLFACSTAFF LISTSERV between 2014-2024.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection contains emails sent to a Faculty-Staff LISTSERV, an email distribution list that allows various departments and offices across UAlbany to notify one another of events and information.

It should be noted that some of the links contained within these emails may be inactive or go to pages no longer associated with the material that they once referenced. If you want to see what the webpages once looked like, most of the albany.edu website has been archived in the Wayback Machine.

prefercite.head: Preferred Citation
prefercite.p: Preferred citation for this material is as follows:

Identification of specific item, series, UAlbany Faculty-Staff Listserv Collection, 2014-2024. M.E. Grenander Department of Special Collections and Archives, University Libraries, University at Albany, State University of New York (hereafter referred to as the UAlbany Faculty-Staff Listserv Collection).

did.unittitle: Today at UAlbany Emails from the Office of Communications and Marketing

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Emails sent from the "Today at UAlbany" email to the Faculty-Staff LISTSERV. "Today at UAlbany" is a daily email meant to share and celebrate UAlbany news with community members including faculty and staff. It was originally sent from the Office of Communications and Marketing until it gained its own email address in 2019, which is why it is included in this series, even though it originally came from the Office of Communicaions and Marketing.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Emails sent from the "Today at UAlbany" email to the Faculty-Staff LISTSERV. "Today at UAlbany" is a daily email meant to share and celebrate UAlbany news with community members including faculty and staff.
